title: Get started
narration: Roomora keeps a shared home or trip balance in one place. To record a new cost, tap Add Expense on the home screen.

title: Enter the expense
narration: Enter the amount, give the expense a clear name, and choose its category. Here, we're adding nine hundred and sixty lira of weekly groceries.

title: Choose who paid
hint: Select the person who actually paid
narration: Under Payer, select the person who actually covered the bill. The payer and the people sharing the cost do not have to be the same.

title: Choose the split
hint: Ece and Mert only: 480 lira each
narration: Under Who is it for, you can choose any combination of members. In this example, only Ece and Mert are selected. Deniz is excluded, so they each owe four hundred and eighty lira.

title: Save the expense
narration: Check the members and the split summary, then tap Save Expense. The expense is added to your group's records.

title: Review the history
narration: On the Expenses screen, you can review each entry by date, category, and payer. Tap an expense to see its details.

title: Check balances
narration: Balance Summary shows exactly how much you owe or are owed by each person. Tap Make Payment when you're ready to settle a debt.

title: Report a payment
hint: Pay in full or enter a custom amount
narration: On the payment screen, fill the full balance with one tap or enter a partial amount. Check the recipient, then report the payment.

title: Track approval
narration: The other person receives a payment request. You can follow pending approvals from Notifications.

title: Approve receipt
hint: Verify the amount, then Approve or Reject
narration: The recipient checks the sender and amount. Once the money arrives, they tap Approve. If something is wrong, they can Reject the report.
